name: SiegeLobby - Default (seed v1)
description: A siege lobby players join with /siege join <key>: timings, voting and the scenario rotation.

steps.description: Name the lobby and the key players type to join it. Only enabled lobbies reach the plugin.

fields.label: Key
fields.description: What players type in /siege join <key>: lowercase letters, digits, - and _; unique.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: The plugin runs the lobby after the next /siege admin reload. Leave off while authoring.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Continuous: matches follow each other with a cooldown. Scheduled lobbies come later.

fields.label: Navigation compass
fields.description: Whether players of this lobby get the navigation compass when they are teleported to the hub, before the match; it is removed with the inventory restore afterwards. Inherit: follow the scenario being played, then the global Siege configuration. Give / DoNotGive: decide for this lobby, whatever the scenario says.

steps.description: How long players wait before and between matches.

fields.label: Matchmaking (seconds)
fields.description: Time to gather players and vote before a match; at least 60.

fields.label: Cooldown between matches (seconds)
fields.description: Pause after a match before matchmaking starts again. Default 900 = 15 minutes.

steps.description: How the next scenario is chosen.

fields.label: Scenarios to vote on
fields.description: How many ready scenarios from the rotation are put up for each vote (1 to 3).

fields.label: Allow a 'random' vote
fields.description: Players may vote for a random scenario instead of a named one.

steps.description: The scenarios this lobby draws its vote candidates from. Add each with Create New Join Entry.

fields.label: Rotation
fields.description: One entry per scenario, with a weight.
